requirements.description: Supported workbook intake: an authenticated upload of a valid .xlsx within 25,000,000 bytes, 50 worksheets and 250,000 nonempty cells is accepted and gets an audit record.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A valid workbook at or below each limit returns 202 with a strict UploadResponse naming its workbook, version and audit.

requirements.description: Invalid or unsupported input (.xls, .xlsm, CSV, missing extension, protected, encrypted, corrupted, over-limit or unsafe packages) is rejected without starting an audit, with the reason explained.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each unsupported input returns its exact rejection status with a ProjectError body and no accepted identifiers.

requirements.description: Original workbook protection: the uploaded source is read-only and never modified, overwritten or published.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The source download is byte-identical (same SHA256) before and after auditing and remediation.

requirements.description: Accessibility evaluation: every accepted workbook gets the six common checks (alternative text, table headers, merged cells, worksheet names, hyperlink text, color and contrast).
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A finished audit reports exactly the independently expected findings for all six rules, and none for the clean fixture.

requirements.description: Actionable findings: each finding names its worksheet and target, explains the barrier, recommends a response and is classified.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each finding validates against the Finding schema with its worksheet, canonical target, classification, nonblank message and recommendation.

requirements.description: Human judgment: meaning-dependent issues request user input or manual review; the system never generates the missing meaning.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Meaning-dependent findings are REQUIRES_USER_INPUT or MANUAL_REVIEW, and an APPLY to a manual-only finding is refused with 422 UNSUPPORTED_CORRECTION.

requirements.description: User-authorized remediation: supported corrections (alternative text, worksheet name, hyperlink text, confirmed header row) are applied only after the user approves them.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each approved correction appears in the output exactly as approved, and declined or omitted findings are left unchanged.

requirements.description: Separate remediated output: a successful remediation produces a new downloadable .xlsx version while the source stays a separate, unchanged version.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The output downloads with its declared SHA256 as a new version whose source version is unchanged.

requirements.description: Workbook preservation: everything not selected for remediation is preserved, and the output opens in Excel without a repair warning.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The independent comparator finds no difference between source and output beyond the approved changes. The Excel no-repair check is manual evidence outside the hosted run.

requirements.description: Audit report: each audit or remediation provides a report with version, date, ruleset, checks performed, findings, approved changes, unresolved and manual items, and limitations.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The downloaded report validates as AuditReport with the run's specification version and matches its audit, and repeated downloads are identical.

requirements.description: Version and status tracking: each upload, remediation and re-audit creates a uniquely identified version or audit, keeps earlier audit records and carries a defined status.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Version and history reads show distinct identifiers, defined statuses and unchanged earlier audits.

requirements.description: Periodic audits (1 to 90 day interval) and deadline reminders 90, 30 and 7 days before a set deadline for workbooks with unresolved findings or no completed audit.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Advancing the isolated clock produces exactly the scheduled audits and reminder records the frozen calendar vectors predict, and none for a clean workbook.

requirements.description: Controlled failure handling: failed uploads, audits, remediations, reports and scheduled audits preserve the source, record the failure, explain it and present nothing partial as complete.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each injected failure yields its exact controlled error, an unchanged source and no successful partial output or report.

requirements.description: Access control and data protection: authentication required, no access to others' workbooks or reports, HTTPS, no plaintext passwords, and owner deletion of stored files and outputs.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Unauthenticated, foreign and ungranted requests are refused with no side effect, and an owner deletion removes every stored artifact. HTTPS and password storage are deployment evidence outside the hosted run.

requirements.description: Accessibility, performance and repeatability: an accessible interface, an audit of a boundary workbook within 60 seconds or a controlled failure, and identical findings on repeated audits.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each timed boundary audit finishes within 60 seconds or fails in a controlled way, and successful repeated audits have identical findings. The interface accessibility part is browser and manual evidence outside the hosted run.

requirements.description: Intake and audit model: Awaiting Upload to Processing on an authenticated upload.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: An authenticated upload is accepted as PROCESSING, and uploads without valid authentication are refused with 401.

requirements.description: Intake and audit model: Processing to Auditing for a valid .xlsx.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A valid workbook's audit leaves PROCESSING and reaches a terminal audit status.

requirements.description: Intake and audit model: Processing to Rejected for invalid or unsupported input, creating no workbook or audit record.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The rejection carries no accepted identifiers, so no workbook or audit exists.

requirements.description: Intake and audit model: Auditing to Audit Complete when there are no findings.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The clean fixture's audit ends AUDIT_COMPLETE with no findings.

requirements.description: Intake and audit model: Auditing to Review Required when human judgment is needed.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A workbook with only manual-review findings ends REVIEW_REQUIRED.

requirements.description: Intake and audit model: Auditing to Remediation Available when a supported correction is found.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A workbook with supported corrections ends REMEDIATION_AVAILABLE with REQUIRES_USER_INPUT findings.

requirements.description: Intake and audit model: Auditing to Processing Failed on a timeout or error, preserving the uploaded source.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: An injected audit failure ends PROCESSING_FAILED with the controlled error and the source unchanged.

requirements.description: Review and remediation model: Review Required to Remediation Available when the user supplies meaning.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A decision supplying the user's value for a REQUIRES_USER_INPUT finding is accepted for remediation.

requirements.description: Review and remediation model: Remediation Available back to Review Required when a correction is declined.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Declined findings remain unresolved in the result and its report, and no edit is made for them.

requirements.description: Review and remediation model: Review Required stays in review when input is not supplied.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: A decision without the required value is refused and the workbook state and history are unchanged.

requirements.description: Review and remediation model: Remediation Available to Remediating when the user approves changes.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Approved decisions are accepted with 202 RemediationAccepted and the remediation reads REMEDIATING until it finishes.

requirements.description: Review and remediation model: Remediating to Remediated when checks pass.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The remediation ends REMEDIATED with a published, preserved output whose re-audit no longer reports the corrected findings.

requirements.description: Review and remediation model: Remediating to Processing Failed when generation or preservation fails; no partial output is downloadable.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: An injected remediation failure publishes no output version, audit or report, and the source is unchanged.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: Stored Version to Audit Scheduled when a 1 to 90 day schedule is enabled.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Intervals 1 and 90 are accepted with the exact next due time; 0 and 91 are refused with 400 and change nothing.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: Audit Scheduled to Scheduled Audit Processing when the scheduled date arrives.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Advancing the clock to the due time accepts exactly one scheduled audit of the stored version.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: a successful scheduled audit saves a new audit record and returns to Audit Scheduled.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The scheduled audit completes as a new audit record, the next due time stays on the original grid, and replaying the clock adds nothing.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: a failed scheduled audit is logged and the schedule is retained.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: An injected scheduled-audit failure is recorded as PROCESSING_FAILED with the source unchanged, and the next interval runs normally.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: Audit Scheduled stays scheduled while not due.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Advancing to just before the due time accepts no scheduled audit.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: Audit Scheduled to Notification Pending when a reminder date arrives.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Each threshold crossing creates exactly one reminder record for an eligible workbook.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: Notification Pending back to Audit Scheduled once the delivery result is recorded; delivery failures do not change audit status.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The reminder records its delivery result (DELIVERED or FAILED) and the workbook's audit status is unchanged.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: Audit Scheduled to New Version Processing when a changed workbook is uploaded.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Uploading a changed workbook creates a new version, and the schedule then follows it without postponing the due time.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: New Version Processing creates a new version that continues in the intake and audit model.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: The new version gets its own audit through the intake flow and appears in history after the earlier versions.

requirements.description: Version, schedule and reminder model: an authorized delete from any stored state reaches Deleted.
requirements.qualifyingAssertion: Owner deletion returns 204, every old URL returns 404, and no later audit or reminder runs for the workbook.
